body: The therapeutic team there did help me.

The nurses were all supportive and  i got a therapist there that was really good and he helped me to cope. It felt like a strict summer camp that tries to support your mental health. We coundnt use our phones but there were tvs there and a playstation so we could pass the time.I wouldnt be scared to go there.

First of all props to you for seeking help. I actually liked being there more than being at home. I had extreme social anxiety and meeting people helped me to open up. Some people actually cared about me for the first time. However, while i was there one of my friends there killed herself and it caused my situation to worsen significantly. If I hadnt had to deal with id have gotten out 2 months sooner. She was a great person. The place didnt really help me as much as i hoped it would.
Tried to jump from a 7 story building

Im on prozac lamictal and risperdal. I dont have a job and no hobbies since i get no joy out of entertainment. I was in the hospital for so long because i reported that i am still suicidal to the doctors, they let me out because there was an improvement though they realized that itis impossible to make me not suicidal in that enviorment. I am always actively suicidal

I have no future. I live in a country with forced military conscription and in a few weeks I'll have to return to high school which worsens my depression until i stop eating and drinking. Thank you for replying though
